scope: Portable authenticated OPTR CPU export/fit/import, reviewed against current v13 native-residual policy. Synthetic CPU fixtures only; no NPU, live model, deployment or performance experiment.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: A valid bundle could be rejected when its original source paths resolve differently on the fitting host, including Linux /tmp versus a Mac /tmp symlink or replaced original directories.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: PortableInputs.logical_path normalizes absolute UNIX identities lexically with posixpath, without resolving destination-host symlinks. The parent agent updated trace/profile resolver seams to use it. Physical bundle files still require resolved containment and size/SHA256 checks.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: Relative model/custom-prompt values could resolve under a different fitting-host working directory and lose the original profile identity.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: Exporter stores canonical absolute source-host model/custom-prompt paths in config and base_config, consistent with the preexisting fingerprint/profile.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: A valid old completed result raised RefitRequired instead of continuing from authenticated raw bundle data.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: Only RefitRequired enters refitting; bad publication hashes, source identity failures, test regressions and other validation errors remain fatal.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: Missing or non-tensor combined-artifact fields could trigger an ambiguous tensor boolean error instead of a clear authentication failure.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: Explicit tensor-type and torch.equal checks; malformed inventory rows and configuration/identity fields also receive explicit validation errors.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: The raw target configuration does not itself activate OPTR, so export/import would reject the normal config without applying the same candidate variant as serving.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: CLI export/import apply serving_variants.variant_config, with --variant candidate as default. Fit accepts only the authenticated bundle configuration and exposes no testing or optimizer override.

confirmed_and_fixed.impact: Export could use an explicitly supplied source manifest outside canonical discovery, while import only searched canonical capture locations.
confirmed_and_fixed.fix: Import now accepts the same optional --trace-manifest, runs existing trace authentication and requires its SHA256 to match the returned certificate. Default canonical discovery remains unchanged.

end_to_end_evidence.source: Real CPU-generated tiny recipe3 pair with authentic completion metadata, whole-record source exclusion, TP manifests and tensor hashes; teachers are explicitly synthetic replay outputs.
end_to_end_evidence.execution: Original serial preparation uses the real nonzero streamed gradient. Export copies original file bytes. Original model, custom source, baseline artifacts and raw capture directories are renamed away. A real spawned production worker performs CPU fitting with the original paths unavailable.
assertions: Bundle JSON/PT/source bytes equal originals at export; model weight files are not transported.
Train candidate metrics, validation metrics, test metrics and accept/reject outcomes equal the serial path.
If rejected, both paths report the same no-improvement error and no refined PT or publication manifest exists.
Worker exits zero and worker cleanup completes.

Child import guards reject torch_npu, vllm, vllm_ascend and transformers; a call observer rejects source-host model identity reads, capture and NPU fitting_device. None are already imported before or present after the worker.

negative_and_resume_coverage: File SHA256 and size changes, including same-size byte corruption after resolver construction.
Traversal, absolute physical inventory path, physical symlink escape, duplicate mappings, missing members and malformed inventory row.
Changed source bytes, excluded records, recipe3 seed binding or model identity despite updated transport inventory hashes.
Test-only header cannot enter production; removing only the header marker still cannot promote synthetic baseline data.
Actual published synthetic result is rejected by the production import entry.
CLI rejects --testing; fitting output cannot reside inside the input bundle; invalid CPU worker budgets fail.
Completed artifact authenticates and reuses; stale implementation invokes refit while bad artifact hashes do not.
Exact compatible v12 raw profile is authenticated under current v13 export; old fitted checkpoint files are not exported.
publication_fixture_disclosure: The positive completed-cache/import-rejection test injects one disclosed tangent using the existing synthetic pipeline fixture. Replay, validation, independent-test gates, hashes and publication are real. The portable spawn/serial comparison uses the actual optimizer without a prescribed direction.

validation.note: Run after logical-path fix and v12 raw compatibility test. A final synthetic-import rejection assertion was subsequently added and included in the focused rerun below.
Final focused rerun also verifies transported input bytes remain unchanged and documents the baseline authentication lock file.
Focused final import/export explicit-manifest CLI propagation; the root agent owns the concurrent complete regression run.

validation.result: passed; documents same-project-revision workflow and no testing switch

limits: Baseline authentication may create/open bundle/base/.oscar.lock and requires a writable directory. Sample/PT bytes are not rewritten; chmod-read-only filesystem operation is not claimed.
These are host functional and integrity checks, not an actual Linux-to-Mac transfer or proof of bitwise equality across Torch/BLAS implementations.
No real NPU-captured production bundle or production publication was exercised; synthetic markers remain enforced.
Checksums detect integrity changes but are not signatures from an external trust authority.
Source-host import requires the original actual model/base/capture and current fitting implementation. A bundle alone does not authorize serving a result.
No model accuracy improvement, NPU equivalence, preparation speedup percentage or end-to-end performance result is claimed.
